name: Jana Novotná
bio:
Jana's journey into motorsport catering began unexpectedly after her family's traditional Czech restaurant near Brno started serving local racing teams. Her knack for anticipating the needs of demanding drivers and mechanics quickly made her indispensable. Jana's approach to catering is deeply rooted in her belief that a well-fed team is a winning team; she prioritizes fresh, high-quality ingredients and familiar comfort foods, adapting recipes to accommodate dietary restrictions without sacrificing flavor.

Having joined Trackhouse Racing, she now brings her European culinary flair to the American circuit. She's known for her meticulous planning, ensuring that every meal is not only delicious but also perfectly timed to optimize performance. Jana's resourcefulness and dedication have earned her the nickname 'The Pit Stop Chef', a testament to her speed and efficiency under pressure.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly tied back in a practical bun
physical.description: A stout woman with a kind face and perpetually rosy cheeks.

quirks: Insists on using a specific Czech brand of paprika in all her spicy dishes.
Always has a stash of homemade plum dumplings (švestkové knedlíky) hidden for 'emergency' energy boosts.
Refers to the drivers as 'my racing stars' and secretly keeps score of who eats the most of her food.
